image_description: A full-body side view of a reddish-brown horse (sorrel/chestnut) standing in a grassy field. The horse has its head lowered towards the ground, possibly grazing or sniffing. It wears a halter. The coat is uniform reddish-brown with a slightly lighter mane and tail. The background includes trees, a fence, and a building structure under bright daylight.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coat is a consistent reddish-brown (chestnut/sorrel). There are no black markings on the lower legs (points) or mane/tail, fitting the 'sorrel' description perfectly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Mane and tail same color as body or lighter (flaxen).

The thoracic region is deep, and the topline (back) appears straight and strong, connecting smoothly to the hindquarters.
The tail is visible hanging down, appearing long and composed of distinct hair strands, consistent with equine anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Long slender legs with single hoof per foot.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All four legs are visible. They are slender relative to the body. Hooves are visible at the bottom of each leg, appearing as single solid structures. No extra limbs or fusion detected.

The halter straps lack crisp edges and detailed buckles, appearing somewhat fused with the fur texture, which is common in AI generations struggling with thin accessories.
